hypothesis: Targeted likely-failure constraints provide at least as strong visible failure-mode control as a broad generic negative stack in a complex environmental portrait.
baseline_prompt: Create a realistic environmental portrait of an adult museum conservator in a quiet restoration studio at dusk. She has just paused while placing a small ceramic fragment into a padded tray, with both hands visible near the work surface. A task lamp and fading window light create a controlled warm-cool contrast. A magnifier, soft brush, blank archival tags, and storage drawers establish the work setting without clutter. Frame her slightly off center, with a shelf edge in the foreground, the conservator and tray in the midground, and tall cabinets receding behind her. Keep the scene observational rather than posed, with natural skin, believable hand-object contact, and readable separation between subject and workspace. Avoid bad anatomy, extra fingers, blur, artifacts, text, watermark, logo.

variants.old: Avoid bad anatomy, extra fingers, blur, artifacts, text, watermark, logo.
variants.new: Avoid distorted fingers around the tray and unintended readable text on the archival tags.

transfer_benchmark.realization: archetype baseline plus broad-negative control clause
